notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in general, and end-game underleveled content. Chroma Rush has a more PvP-oriented trait perk pool, but the origin trait the boosts handling and reload makes it viable, if you're still looking for a kinetic slot rapid fire auto-rifle. At base, the stats are decent - 25 Range equates to 22.20m ADS and 13.88m hipfire, 56 stability, 35 Handling is 0.42s ready, 0.32s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, and 47 Reload Speed is a 1.86s reload (1.49s with the intrinsic rapid-fire frame boost if you reload from an empty mag). The recoil direction is mostly vertical, if loose - you can improve control with the barrel perk or, if you're comfortable maybe push out the range a little. In the magazine, on controller, a bit more Stability is nice, boost reload speed further or add some extra bullets. For the trait perk slots, Subsistence is the best for PvE in the first column, while in the second Kinetic Tremors (although the damage scaling isn't great for the AoE shockwave), or Frenzy for a ×1.15 damage boost and max Handling and Reload Speed both work. The Splicer Surge origin trait is nice for PvE - reload after dealing damage for up to three stacks, which boosts handling and reload speed by 10/20/45 and applies a reload animation multiplier of ×0.967/×0.934/×0.9. Recommended MW: Range or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create power orbs or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Rapid-Fire Autos frequently manage to be a sleeper pick in PvP due to their Optimal TTK being 0.75s (exception being T10 Resilience at 0.83s) and this one is no different. Chroma Rush brings a respectable selection of perks, with many options to boost lower stats and/or increase damage. Target Lock can smooth out the TTK to 0.75s or Kill Clip with its blistering 0.58s for T9 and below! Combined with the origin trait, Chroma Rush will feel quite lethal and snappy!" Recommended MW: Reload Speed.
